correctness.rationale: Planar Steinitz gives a rigorous global length cutoff 21 (21 lattice prefix positions). Every atom of length >=3 uses at most one of each antipodal pair. All 64 orientations are exhaustively enumerated using 809600 exact integer pivot/free coefficient calculations; a free-degree antichain induction proves completeness. A separate direct length<=9 scan, proper-subset checks and exact D4 orbits reproduce all 47 atoms and maximal length five. The finite proof explicitly depends on the established Steinitz theorem.

value.rationale: The radius-two disk is the canonical first nontrivial planar Euclidean-ball Davenport instance following the source radius-one case. A complete list of 47 primitive zero-sum types, exact D=5, and two non-equivalent maximum-support configurations directly addresses the motivated inverse/support questions and provides finite structural data for the cited general-radius program. This is a full natural finite classification, not an arbitrary slice.
